answers.in-scope-numbersvalidator-en:
NumbersValidator is a production web tool Ivan built at Liketelecom to clean, validate and convert phone numbers. It can detect number types and regions and process XLS/XLSX files in batches.

He built it with JavaScript, google-libphonenumber and PHP. The tool was used by clients for about six months and is no longer in use.
answers.unknown-google-en: I don’t have information that Ivan worked at Google. You can ask him directly through the contacts on his CV page.
answers.in-scope-projects-en:
Ivan’s projects include:

- **This website** — his current project, with a text CV and me, Elio, a RAG assistant.
- **NumbersValidator** — a production tool for validating phone numbers, built at Liketelecom and published on [GitHub](https://github.com/IvanVasiunin/NumbersValidator).
- **Two job-application test tasks** — a user-management table and a dashboard with an interactive chart.
- **Study projects** — including a food-order app, a project-management app and React testing exercises.

You can explore his repositories on [GitHub](https://github.com/IvanVasiunin).
